properties.description:

changing water levels due to an approaching wake low pressure system.

Water levels dropped over a foot at Point Iroquois between noon and
130PM, and in excess of 2 feet at SW Pier since 1pm.

next several hours Largest changes in water levels...up to 3 to 4
feet or more...can be expected on upper portions of the river from
Point Iroquois to the locks at Sault Ste. Marie.  Water level
changes up to one foot can be expected from below the Soo Locks to
Munuscong Lake.

levels...particularly for operators above the Soo Locks.  Be sure to
monitor marine radio for information on this situation.
